capabilities: Chat with the vibe CLI in a streaming sidebar panel with insert/copy and stop controls
Run note commands that summarize, extract Tasks-plugin action items, rewrite, or translate the current note or selection
Register custom skills from .agents/skills/ as commands via auto-discovery
Persist chat history and resume vibe sessions across Obsidian reloads
Show per-turn cost, turn count, and duration telemetry from vibe session metadata
extras: Must be installed manually by copy or symlink since it is not in the community plugin store; README warns that note content and chat messages are sent to Mistral's API by vibe and that the auto-approve agent setting allows arbitrary shell execution.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to use the Mistral Vibe CLI for in-vault AI chat or one-shot note commands.

relations.evidence: Drives the vibe CLI as a subprocess to add chat and predefined tasks to your vault.
Extract action items (Obsidian Tasks plugin syntax)

summary: Mistral Vibe CLI integration that adds a streaming chat panel and predefined note commands (summarize, extract tasks, rewrite, translate) driven by the vibe subprocess.
